The [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] '''conquered''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kuar]] and set up camps there.<ref name="TEGtW" /> They wiped out most of the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Kuarian]]s.<ref name="I8" /> When [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] later challenged [[Mandalore the Indomitable]] to a [[Duel on Kuar|duel]], it was held on Kuar because the Mandalorians already controlled the world.<ref name="TEGtW" />
